summary: Added sdk/reports/economy.py: TradeRecord, LedgerRecord, EconomyRow, compute_economy_report (market return = completed sell proceeds minus completed buy cost per currency, None without a completed trade; fees shown separately; expired and unreconciled counts; ledger gained/spent/samples, window and per-hour gain with None when unobserved; spend by action; unattributed and ambiguous entry counts) plus JSON and Markdown output. Exported from sdk.reports. 6 tests in tests/test_economy_report.py. Documented in docs/baseline/economy-report.md.

contract_status_changes.before: No market return or resource-allocation metric existed
contract_status_changes.after: Market return and resource allocation are reported per account and variant from reconciled trades and ledgers, with sample counts

residual_risks: Real market figures need SellItem3/Purchase4, which remain unimplemented pending owner captures.
